SELECT id, name, unit, calories_kcal_per_100g, gi_value, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM ingredient ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ingredient(name, unit, calories_kcal_per_100g, gi_value, remark) VALUES (#{name}, #{unit}, #{caloriesKcalPer100g}, #{giValue}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE ingredient SET name = #{name}, unit = #{unit}, calories_kcal_per_100g = #{caloriesKcalPer100g}, gi_value = #{giValue}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
